historicalEvidence.reproducer: dynamic JSON records, dynamic strings/maps/sets, and an unbounded observation map

notes: The closed lifecycle and classification laws are moved to src/mncs_commons/mesh/mncs/commons/pressure/lifecycle.mncs. This record tracks the remaining dynamic projection boundary, not unavoidable filesystem transport.

reproducer.attemptedProgram: mncs 0.18; module commons.pressure.projection; ingest bounded typed pressure rows and fold typed lifecycle observations
reproducer.expected: Profile 0.18 can express bounded typed classification and folding. It does not make unbounded dynamic JSON/maps or external filesystem enumeration native; those remain explicit host boundaries.

requiredBehavior: A native Commons semantic layer should classify bounded typed pressure rows, fold lifecycle observations, and expose deterministic query predicates over structured records without re-implementing those rules in a host language. Filesystem enumeration, Git provenance, and publication may remain host boundaries.
summary: The old Profile 0.16 reproducer overclaimed a need for a Python-style dynamic object model. Against Profile 0.18, the closed lifecycle/classification and bounded typed query slice are representable; the remaining pressure is the missing reusable bounded structured-record projection plus external enumeration/publication boundaries, not dynamic registry semantics as a whole.
title: Dynamic registry projection cannot yet be native MNCS
